Plugin.Name: Thunderbolt Net
Plugin.Overview: Host-to-host networking over Thunderbolt 3/4/5 and USB4 / USB4 v2 wherever Linux exposes thunderbolt_net. Multi-peer tbn tabs, trained link rate and lane status, services on Thunderbolt IPs, known peers; optional OpenFabric when FRR is installed (Fabric Routing companion). Configure under Settings → Network Settings → Thunderbolt / tbnN.
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: Thunderbolt ThunderboltNet USB4 tbn host-net OpenFabric
